# foundry_evaluation_taxonomy (Data Source)

~> **Preview:** This data source requires `enable_preview = ["evaluations"]` on the provider. Preview features may change their inputs, outputs, or behavior in any provider release without following semantic versioning.

Looks up a Foundry evaluation taxonomy by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Evaluations are a preview feature; opt in on the provider block:
# provider "foundry" {
#   enable_preview = ["evaluations"]
# }

data "foundry_evaluation_taxonomy" "safety" {
  name = "customer-support-safety"
}

output "risk_categories" {
  value = data.foundry_evaluation_taxonomy.safety.categories
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the taxonomy.

### Read-Only

- `agent_name` (String) Name of the Foundry agent the taxonomy is generated for.
- `agent_version` (String) Version of the Foundry agent the taxonomy is generated for.
- `categories` (Attributes List) Categories generated by the service for the taxonomy, in the order returned by the service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--categories))
- `description` (String) Description of the taxonomy.
- `id` (String) Service-assigned taxonomy identifier.
- `risk_categories` (List of String) Risk categories the taxonomy was generated for.
- `version` (String) Service-assigned taxonomy version.

<a id="nestedatt--categories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `categories`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Category description.
- `id` (String) Service-assigned category identifier.
- `name` (String) Category name.
- `risk_category` (String) Risk category this category belongs to.
- `sub_categories` (Attributes List) Subcategories within this category, in the order returned by the service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--categories--sub_categories))

<a id="nestedatt--categories--sub_categories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `categories.sub_categories`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Subcategory description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the subcategory is enabled for evaluation.
- `id` (String) Service-assigned subcategory identifier.
- `name` (String) Subcategory name.
